generation.description: Combines multiple compatible artistic techniques into one creative visual composition.
generation.visualIdentity: A controlled combination of illustration, painting, textures, graphic design and mixed media.
generation.linework: Combination of clean digital outlines, hand-drawn marks and painterly edges.
generation.textures: Layered paper, watercolor, digital paint, grain, brush strokes and collage textures.
generation.characters: Characters use one consistent primary design language while allowing mixed-media surface treatments.
generation.backgrounds: Can combine painted landscapes, geometric elements, photographic-inspired textures and illustrated environments.
generation.lighting: Expressive lighting with layered highlights and shadows.
generation.composition: Collage-inspired compositions with multiple visual layers and balanced focal points.
generation.instructions: Blend two or more compatible artistic techniques while preserving a coherent visual identity. Avoid making characters look disconnected from their environment.
generation.promptModifier: Render using a sophisticated mixed-media art aesthetic combining compatible illustration techniques, painterly textures, layered materials, graphic elements and artistic surface details. Blend techniques harmoniously while maintaining visual coherence and preserving the original subject.
generation.negativePrompt: Unintentional style clashes, messy collage, excessive textures, inconsistent character rendering, visual clutter.
generation.negativeModifier: Chaotic collage, conflicting artistic styles, random textures, excessive visual noise.
